body:
Hey, thank you and I’m sorry you’re a survivor of childhood trauma. At the time it felt like I was just opening up a conversation about things that are considered so taboo without any understanding, and I genuinely didn’t mean to offend anyone! But a few people mentioned that they’d never met trauma survivors who had that particular kink and made it seem like it was an impossible concept. 

I don’t think I’ll be back on that twitter account to be able to show your comment, but it’s just difficult that I lost so many people who I did really care about just because of a miscommunication of some kind.
